name: Almutawa - Subscriptions & Reminders Watcher
description: Hourly: sends inbox + Telegram reminders for due subscriptions/top-ups (with payment link), custom reminders, and a weekly nudge for subscriptions missing details.

parameters.query:
WITH bh AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain') AS t),
r AS (UPDATE reminders SET last_sent_at = now(), status = CASE WHEN repeat_daily_until_done THEN status ELSE 'sent' END WHERE status = 'pending' AND due_at <= now() AND (last_sent_at IS NULL OR (repeat_daily_until_done AND last_sent_at < now() - interval '23 hours')) RETURNING id, title, body, link),
s AS (UPDATE subscriptions SET last_reminded_on = (SELECT t::date FROM bh) WHERE (SELECT extract(hour FROM t) FROM bh) >= 9 AND status = 'active' AND decision <> 'cancel' AND next_due IS NOT NULL AND (snooze_until IS NULL OR snooze_until <= (SELECT t::date FROM bh)) AND next_due - remind_days_before <= (SELECT t::date FROM bh) AND (last_reminded_on IS NULL OR last_reminded_on < (SELECT t::date FROM bh)) RETURNING id, name, next_due, cost, currency, manage_url, kind),
w AS (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'to_review'),
items AS (
SELECT 'reminder' AS category, '⏰ تذكير: ' || title AS title, coalesce(body, '') || CASE WHEN link IS NOT NULL THEN E'\nالرابط: ' || link ELSE '' END AS body, 'high' AS priority, 'reminders' AS entity, id::text AS entity_id,
 '⏰ تذكير (رقم ' || id || '): ' || title || coalesce(E'\n' || body, '') || coalesce(E'\nالرابط: ' || link, '') || E'\n\nخلصتها؟ رد علي هنا: تم / ذكرني بكرة / ذكرني الساعة كذا' AS agent_msg FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'subscription', CASE WHEN next_due < (SELECT t::date FROM bh) THEN '⚠️ فات موعد ' || name ELSE CASE WHEN kind = 'prepaid' THEN '💳 وقت شحن رصيد ' || name ELSE '💳 قرّب تجديد ' || name END END,
 'الموعد: ' || to_char(next_due, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || coalesce(' · المبلغ: ' || cost || ' ' || currency, '') || E'\nرد على الوكيل: دفعت / لا تجدده / ذكرني بعد يوم' || coalesce(E'\nرابط الدفع: ' || manage_url, ''),
 CASE WHEN next_due < (SELECT t::date FROM bh) THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'high' END, 'subscriptions', id::text,
 CASE WHEN next_due < (SELECT t::date FROM bh) THEN '⚠️ ' || name || ' (اشتراك رقم ' || id || '): فات موعده بتاريخ ' ELSE '💳 ' || name || ' (اشتراك رقم ' || id || '): موعد ' || CASE WHEN kind = 'prepaid' THEN 'الشحن ' ELSE 'التجديد ' END END || to_char(next_due, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || coalesce(E'\nالمبلغ: ' || cost || ' ' || currency, '') || coalesce(E'\nرابط الدفع: ' || manage_url, '') || E'\n\nدفعت؟ رد علي هنا: دفعت / لا تجدده / ذكرني بعد يوم' FROM s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'subscription', '📋 عندك ' || c || ' اشتراكات ناقصة معلوماتها', 'افتح محادثة متابعات الوكيل ونكملها وحدة وحدة.', 'normal', 'subscriptions', 'review',
 '📋 عندك ' || c || E' اشتراكات ناقصة معلوماتها (ليش مشتركين، متى التجديد، كم السعر).\nتبي نكملها الحين؟ قول: يلا' FROM w, bh WHERE c > 0 AND extract(dow FROM t) = 0 AND extract(hour FROM t) = 9
),
ins AS (INSERT INTO agent_chat_histories (session_id, message) SELECT 'staff1_followups', jsonb_build_object('type', 'ai', 'content', agent_msg, 'tool_calls', '[]'::jsonb, 'additional_kwargs', '{}'::jsonb, 'response_metadata', '{}'::jsonb, 'invalid_tool_calls', '[]'::jsonb) FROM items RETURNING id),
cs AS (INSERT INTO chat_sessions (session_id, staff_id, title, status) SELECT 'staff1_followups', 1, '📌 متابعات الوكيل', 'open' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'open', closed_at = NULL, title = EXCLUDED.title RETURNING session_id)
SELECT category, '📌 الوكيل: ' || title AS title, body || E'\nرد عليه في محادثة «متابعات الوكيل»' AS body, priority, entity, entity_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS posted, (SELECT count(*) FROM cs) AS session FROM items
